analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly revenue for the second consecutive quarter in Q2 FY27, driven by strong performance in the Process and Insulating Oil segment and elevated gross margin spreads of approximately INR 29,128 per kiloliter. Management highlighted that operating environments remain challenging due to West Asian geopolitical tensions and shipping disruptions affecting base oil availability and export volumes, particularly at their UAE subsidiary Texol. The company successfully maintained uninterrupted customer supplies through optimized sourcing strategies, robust domestic volume growth, and a debt-free standalone balance sheet. Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly performance for Q2 FY27 with revenue of ₹1,847 crore and PAT of ₹186 crore, driven by sourcing agility and disciplined inventory management. Management noted strong demand and volume traction in process and insulating oils (PIO), alongside sequential improvements in lubricants.

guidance.claim: Management remains quite optimistic about sustaining the currently earned gross margins in the upcoming quarters.
guidance.quote: We remain optimistic in ensuring the margins that we are currently getting, the gross margins that we are currently earning to be protected in the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates base oil pricing to remain on the higher side given the elevated pricing of crude.
guidance.quote: With the elevated pricing of crude, we anticipate the base oil pricing also will be on the higher side.

guidance.claim: Management is quite optimistic about sustaining the margins achieved across the past two quarters for quarter three and quarter four.
guidance.quote: I mean, obviously, we remain quite optimistic in sustaining the margins that we have given across the past 2 quarters.

guidance.claim: The company targets volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates the transformer oil or PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and upcoming quarters.
guidance.quote: we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO segment experienced healthy demand from transformers, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees encouraging long-term growth opportunities for the PIO segment due to increasing electricity demand and power infrastructure investments globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing electricity demand and continued investment in the power infrastructure in India and globally, we see encouraging long-term growth opportunity for this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand environment remains encouraging despite global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments, the underlying demand environment remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong traction in process and insulating oils (PIO) with half-yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business grew 28% year-on-year supported by demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The lubricant business remained broadly stable, providing a resilient revenue base.
demand_outlook.quote: While the lubricant business remained broadly stable, it continued to provide a resilient revenue base and reinforce strength of our diversified portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Export business recorded a robust 54% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our export business recorded a robust 54% year-on-year growth, reflecting expanding global customer relationships and a growing international footprint, which further strengthened our overall business momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the industry is supposed to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally according to a CRISIL report.
demand_outlook.quote: See, if you look at the CRISIL report, which we did 1.5 years back, the industry is supposed to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry growth in specialty oils is projected at about 6% to 7% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: the growth that we see in this industry of about 6% to 7% CAGR is more than enough for us to grow at about 8% to 10% in volume terms.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for Indian plants stands at 602,713 kiloliters following capital work-in-progress capitalization.
capex_expansion.quote: Having enumerated the same, our installed capacity for the Indian plants now stood at 602,713.

capex_expansion.claim: Texol's installed capacity remains unchanged at 235,924 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: As the installed capacity remains unchanged of Texol of 2,35,924, the total installed capacity now stands at 838,000 which is an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing capacity of 5,98,000, which is basically on account of the capitalization over the last few quarters of the capital WIP.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter stood at INR 388 crores with a gross margin of 21%.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin spread was approximately INR 29,128 per kiloliter.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 288 crores, representing 15.6% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR288 crores compared with INR66 crores in Q2 FY '26, a growth of approximately 337% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: An ex gratia of INR 15 crores to INR 16 crores was paid across the board, impacting employee expenses.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to INR 8,274 per kilolitre.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared with approximately INR 8,274 per kilolitre under a normal operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: The consolidated gross margin percentage for the quarter was 21.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: H1 volume for the PIO segment grew 23% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: This business continued to deliver a very strong performance with H1 volume growing 23% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone capacity utilization is currently 82% to be precise.
orders_capacity.quote: So, I can tell you currently, currently the utilization on stand-alone level is 80%, 82% to be precise.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the consolidated level is around 61%.
orders_capacity.quote: The consol level, it is around 61%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Taloja manufacturing facility is operating near 100% utilisation.
Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: PIO manufacturing volumes increased from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
orders_capacity.quote: PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization across all 3 plants taken together is around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

capital_allocation.claim: The standalone company remains debt-free as of date.
capital_allocation.quote: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR 85 crores as of September 30, 2026, down from INR 168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Total equity increased to INR 1,771 crores from INR 1,400 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed credit ratings and rated bank facilities were enhanced to ₹1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: The reaffirmation of our credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of our rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore further strengthen our financial flexibility.

capital_allocation.claim: The stand-alone company Gandhar Oil is effectively debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of its shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment remained challenging due to ongoing West Asian tensions and global shipping route disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Base oil availability and prices remained uncertain while freight and insurance costs continued to affect supply chain planning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our key raw material base oil availability and prices remain uncertain and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Silvassa unit 2 experienced heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July, resulting in an inventory and exception loss of approximately INR 21 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: As shared earlier, our Silvassa unit 2 was affected by a heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export volumes moderated during the quarter primarily due to West Asian geopolitical developments impacting shipping and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, export volume had moderated during this quarter, primarily due to the geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on the shipping and logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused a disruption at Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, which was subsequently restored in early August.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz concerns, and crude oil volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at subsidiary Texol were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on expanding its customer base, strengthening existing relationships, and improving its product mix to support future growth in the lubricant business.
management_commitments.quote: We view this sequential improvement positively and we will continue to focus on expanding our customer base, strengthening existing relationships and improving our product mix to support our future growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on serving international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities in exports despite near-term challenging conditions.
management_commitments.quote: While the near-term condition remains challenging, exports continue to be an important part of the business, and we remain focused on serving our international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Texol unit's focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service, and minimizing external disruption impacts.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service and managing and minimizing the impact of external disruption.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that company priorities remain deepening presence across segments, expanding geographies, moving into higher value chains, and expanding capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Moving ahead, our priorities remain clear: deepen our presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain and expand capacity.

management_commitments.claim: Capital allocation priorities remain focused on funding growth capex largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet, and creating sustainable long-term value.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated it will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding geographic presence, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to 11% for the year.
management_commitments.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects margins to continue at stellar levels for at least the next one or two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: obviously, this has been a historical good quarter. But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management will announce capex plans shortly in the next quarter or so.
management_commitments.quote: our capex plans will be shortly announced. We are drawing up the same, and we'll get back to you on that in the next quarter or so.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
